method: Exact installed dependency JAR property definitions and runtime parsing without connecting
Exact installed dependency JAR bytecode inspection

mysql_connector_j.verified_mapping: StandardSocketFactory passes the configured socket-connect timeout to Socket.connect. This is not a whole HTTP request deadline.
NativeSocketConnection passes the configured network socket timeout to Socket.setSoTimeout. This is not a total transaction deadline.
NativeProtocol parses the explicit geographic zone with ZoneId and sets the driver connection timezone.
NativeProtocol.configureTimeZone sends SET SESSION time_zone using the configured geographic zone when enabled. A geographic zone requires corresponding server timezone data.

hikari_cp.verified_mapping: HikariPool.getConnection passes this timeout to ConcurrentBag.borrow with TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS. It limits pool acquisition, not query execution.
HikariConfig stores and validates this as a millisecond connection validation timeout.

HikariPool schedules MaxLifetimeTask in milliseconds with per-connection negative variance. Expiry marks a connection for soft eviction; an in-use connection is not forcibly terminated at exactly five minutes.
HikariPool only schedules KeepaliveTask for positive values; zero disables scheduled keepalive.

limitations: No database or Redis connection was created by this static inspection.
No delayed connection, read timeout, pool exhaustion or five-minute connection-lifetime experiment was run.
No SELECT @@session.time_zone query was executed by this inspection.
Successful real TLS connections and application scenarios are reported separately in runtime-summary.json; this artifact does not extend those observations.
